brief:
Two Israeli directors won a special jury prize at the Venice Film Festival on Saturday for a documentary examining Israel's use of artificial intelligence in civilian deaths in Gaza, Al-Monitor reported. The film offers a critical examination of automated targeting systems deployed during the conflict.

The award comes as international film festivals increasingly program work addressing the war's civilian toll and the role of emerging technologies in modern armed conflict.
dek: A chilling new documentary about Israel's AI-assisted killing of civilians in Gaza by two Israeli directors won a special jury prize at the Venice Film Festival on Saturday.
title: Israeli documentary on Gaza AI killings wins Venice jury prize
